name: 셋이서문학관

alt: 【1993년 4월 29일 · 서울】 '귀천'의 시인 천상병 별세 — 기사 장면을 사진풍으로 재구성한 AI 이미지.
visualStyle: Mid-to-late twentieth-century black-and-white 35mm press photograph texture, visible irregular organic film grain, candid tonal contrast, subtle printing imperfections, readable faces and subject, minimal scratches.
sceneBrief: 1993 memorial for poet Cheon Sang-byeong: quiet modest Seoul mourning room, anonymous readers and writers paying respects beside white flowers, closed poetry books and tea cup. No legible poems or invented portrait.
